1: If you want to access the character menu, you can do so by hitting the (c) button.
Make sure to stop by from time to time. You never know who might show up.
Equipment vendors will show you how an item can improve or hurt your fighting ability. If an item type doesn't show any change, your class can't use it.
Heavier armor provides better protection but lowers your mobility in combat. Choose carefully.
5: How did you like that stat bonus at level 4? You get another every 4th level, so plan your promotions accordingly.
If you get a quest from someone, come back and talk with them after it is completed and they will likely reward you for your efforts.
10: Locked chests contain more powerful items compared with unlocked ones, however you need a key or a lockpick to get to the treasure.
Boss enemies have true sight, so that Invisibility Pendant is useless against them.
Some status effects last until the end of combat or until healed. Make sure to stock up on potions!
25: The whole room gets quieter when you come back from a boss fight. That's respect, friend, even if nobody says it outright.
If the Sergeant starts sounding less angry and more worried, that means you are getting close to something important.
People keep asking how many relics you have found. I keep telling them that counting relics is easier than counting what they cost.
65: After the Jester fell, three people paid their tabs without making a single joke. I have never seen this room so relieved.
The old warehouse guards asked me to set aside food for the scientists. Whatever they are building, it keeps them awake for days.
When word came that Merzhin's realm collapsed, the old warehouse crowd bought a round and looked more frightened than happy.

1: Entering the town will replenish your health and mana. Seems like you could take advantage of that.
Sorry, I can't talk now! I am getting married and need to make as much money as I can.
5: Some spells can be cast outside of battle. You can do so in the Character Menu after inspecting the spell.
10: (sobbing) I can't believe it...a week before our wedding and my husband to be decides to join the fight against the prime evil...I want to be mad but he says he can't stand by when I am in danger. My hero...
25: Joffrey returned yesterday bloodied but resolute. He has gained much experience and hopes to have found the source of our suffering by month's end. I gave him my lucky pendant to return to me when his mission is complete.
50: The deeper reports sound less like monster stories and more like warnings left by people who knew they would not get another chance.
When relic-light comes through that door, everyone notices. They just pretend they were looking somewhere else.

10: You may find locked doors along your path while exploring the dungeon. You can't open these with just any old key, you need an actual Old Key.
Watch your carry weight in the Character Menu. If you try to carry more than you can manage, you will become encumbered, which affects your speed in combat.
Check the shops periodically, you may notice new items available to buy.
25: I just finished my shift guarding the old warehouse behind the barracks. They won't tell us what's in there but I have seen several scientists come and go.
50: The Sergeant keeps a ledger of every relic report. If you bring him proof, he'll know exactly which blood-soaked story it belongs to.
After the Iron Golem fell, the engineers started hauling brass coils toward the old warehouse. Something big is coming.
Every boss report changes the patrol map. The lines get cleaner, but the margins keep getting darker.
65: The final evil is not just another monster. The relic reports say ordinary strength will not be enough when the Evening Star opens its eye.
The reports from Cambion do not read like normal patrol notes. Left turns become right turns, doors forget where they open, and every survivor swears Merzhin was laughing from somewhere else.
The Realm of Cambion no longer spits patrol markers back at us, but nobody trusts a victory over a place that learned how to lie.

8: (hic)...I am not as think as you drunk I am...(hic)
25: Do you see (hic) that person in the corner? What's their deal, TAKE THE HOOD OFF ALREADY!...ah whatever...
30: (hic)...I heard tell there were secret passages...(hic) in the dungeon.
65: We are all praying for your success and survival!
Rutger used to talk about a so-called Master key, that could open any lock. I wonder how much truth was in that.
Six relics, one hero, no sane odds. Good thing nobody asked the odds. (hic)

1: The waitress left crying some time ago...sounds like her fiance was killed in the dungeons.
Entering the town will replenish your health and mana. Seems like you could take advantage of that.
Some spells can be cast outside of battle. You can do so in the Character Menu after inspecting the spell.
The guy in the corner gives me the creeps...tips well though.
20: A soldier came in after patrol, pale as milk, saying the walls themselves shifted down there.
People leave notes under their cups now. Names of monsters, places they saw lights, that kind of thing. I pretend not to read them.
50: The scientists tip in strange coins and smell like ozone. They keep asking whether the fifth floor is still intact.
One of the guards said the relics hum louder when they are brought near each other. I have been trying very hard not to think about that.
The more guardian names people cross off the wall, the less anyone wants to stand near the wall.
65: A guard left a note under his cup that just said, 'The Jester is gone.' Nobody touched the table for an hour.
Someone from the old warehouse said the portal room smells like rain after you come back from Cambion. I hope that means you came back in one piece.
After Merzhin fell, the portal-room scientists stopped laughing at their own jokes. I think they finally saw what was looking back.

50: Your power has grown...I am impressed.
The relics do not gather by accident. Neither do witnesses.
60: Have you defeated the Red Dragon yet?

Barkeep: Good. I'll keep your seat warm and an ear open for word of your return.
Fair enough. The offer stays on the bar if courage finds you later.
Waitress: Thank you. I know it is dangerous, but I will be hoping for you every step.
I understand. I should not have put one more burden on you.
Busboy: Good. I'll make sure nobody clears your table before you get back.
Right. Forget I said anything; I've got enough spills to clean up.
Soldier: Excellent. Report back when the objective is complete.
Then stand aside. We have no room for half-measures.
Drunkard: That's the spirit...or spirits? Either way, I'll be right here when you get back. (hic)
Sure, sure, leave the old drunk to worry about it. (hic)
Hooded Figure: Splendid. Threads move when the willing hand takes hold.
Pity. Promise without motion is only another shadow.
Griswold: Ha! I knew there was steel in you. Come back in one piece.
Fine, but keep your eyes open. Trouble rarely waits for permission.
Alchemist: Excellent. Field results are always cleaner than theory.
A disappointing refusal, but even negative results teach something.
Jeweler: Marvelous. Bring it back untarnished if you can.
A curious choice, but value is often a matter of timing.
Priest: May Elysia's light steady your hand and soften your fear.
Then I will wait, and pray that another path opens.
Sergeant: Outstanding. Complete the mission and report directly back to me.
Dismissed, then. Do not mistake hesitation for strategy.

tavern_flavor_dialogues: I heard there are powerful artifacts deep in the dungeon...
Many adventurers have entered the dungeon, but few return.
They say the evil grows stronger with each passing day.
Word travels fast after a boss falls. Even the quiet patrons listen for your boots at the door.
The Sergeant's people have started pinning monster sketches over the barracks map.
A pair of scientists keep arguing about something called a stable descent field.
Be careful down there, adventurer. The monsters are cunning.
I lost my brother to the dungeon. Please, be safe.
The blacksmith Griswold is the best in the kingdom!
If you need potions, visit the alchemist. They saved my life once.
I've heard rumors of a secret shop somewhere in the depths...
The Bounty Board offers rewards for hunting dangerous creatures.
The quartermaster has started leaving supplies in proven adventurers' storage lockers.
Some victories make the tavern louder. Others make everyone lower their voices and count who came home.
Some say there's treasure beyond imagination in the depths.
